prompt: We're an online platform subject to the DSA. How do our DSA obligations interact with GDPR?
assertions: Cites the EDPB's FINAL Guidelines on the DSA–GDPR interplay (Guidelines 3/2025, finalised September 2026)
States the core principle: cumulative, coherent application — DSA compliance does not displace GDPR duties

Gives concrete touchpoints: notice-and-action, recommender-system transparency/options, and the DSA advertising bans (profiling with special-category data; ads targeted at minors) all involve personal data and need a GDPR lawful basis
Notes regulator coordination: Digital Services Coordinators/Commission and DPAs are steered toward consistent enforcement
Gives practical advice: map each DSA-driven processing operation into the RoPA with its own basis and transparency
